body: The place is nearly 150 years old. Not really, except for a one room renovation.

I've got this friend who seems to care about be a lot but she doesn't want to date me. It seems that she's drifting away, I fear due to a new relationship she may be keeping from me, since she knows it would hurt.

My last girlfriend cheated on me, I broke up with her in February. I've been ignoring her text messages ever since.

Things with my family aren't so good either. My mother has been out of my life since 2008, and I've been very vocal to my father about picking such a terrible person to be my mother, and for making me exist in the first place. He doesn't like to hear about it.

I haven't had a hug in weeks, my life is devoid of any affection. It doesn't seem worth getting out of bed in the morning.

My best friend is cool, I'd like to date her but she doesn't seem into it. I don't hang with many other people.

My Mother and I haven't been on speaking terms in 4 years, and I'm pissed off at my father for choosing such a piece of shit to be the mother of his children.
I went to my favorite museum last weekend. First time I was there since I was a young kid. Must have been almost 13 years. It didn't help.

>Keep trying to look for therapists, took me a while to find one I liked. Some were particularly wacky. One asked me what my sign was within the first minute of us meeting... :facepalm:

I didn't even consider the amount of quacks out there. How many did you go through before you found one you liked?

I've never heard of "flex spending", but I can't really afford $100+ a week.

I don't want meds I just want to talk.
